title: Great idea, bad execution
body: I have only tried 3 recipes so far and all of them were terrible. The portion size modification for two people modifies the ingredients list but not the instructions making it very easy to add the incorrect ingredient amount. And the measurements are not user-friendly. 15 tablespoons is just bizarre. Convert it to mL or cups. Measuring 0.67 oz of anything is not realistic. I could deal with that part if the recipes weren’t garbage. I told it I wanted healthy recipes and I gave me recipes a 6-year-old might like. Not for me.

title: Bad experience so far, potentially not great for a gluten-free diet.
body: First time around I chose high protein and it was only giving me keto recipes.
